units.source_text: 源氏大将回家之后想道：“我还有何面目再见藤壶皇后呢？

en.t: After returning home, General Genji thought, "How can I ever face Empress Fujitsubo again?

units.source_text: 在她没有谅解我的苦心之前，我不再理她。”

en.t: Until she understands the pain and effort behind what I have done, I will have nothing more to do with her."

units.source_text: 因此别后连慰问信也不写。

en.t: For that reason, after they parted he did not even write her a letter of comfort.

units.source_text: 他也不进宫，也不去望皇太子，

en.t: He did not go to court, nor did he visit the Crown Prince,

units.source_text: 只是笼闭一室，日夜悲叹藤壶皇后的冷酷无情，

en.t: but shut himself up in one room, lamenting day and night Empress Fujitsubo's cold heartlessness,

units.source_text: 那愁眉苦脸，旁人看了也伤心。

en.t: and his sorrowful expression was so painful that even those around him were saddened to see it.

units.source_text: 想是神魂不安之故吧，竟变得四肢乏力，有似患病。

en.t: Perhaps because his spirit was so unsettled, his limbs grew weak, as if he had fallen ill.

units.source_text: 但觉人世毫无意趣，真如古人所云：“沉浮尘世间，徒自添烦恼。

en.t: He felt that life in this world held no pleasure at all, just as the ancients said: "Drifting up and down in the dusty world only adds to one's troubles.

units.source_text: 何当入深山，从此出世表。”

en.t: When shall I enter the deep mountains and from then on pass beyond the world?"
Thus the thought of taking religious vows and leaving worldly life arose in him.

units.source_text: 然而这个紫姬实在可爱，她一心一意地依赖源氏，毕竟使他难于舍弃。

en.t: Yet Lady Murasaki was truly dear to him, and because she depended on Genji with all her heart, he found it impossible in the end to abandon her.
